decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and there is no later evidence of results, so it sits weakly against aspirations; still, it is close to the firm's vehicle know-how and there is no clear shortfall signal that would force dropping it.

The inclined furniture lift had its own page, which points to a deliberate shift into lifting equipment after the mining vehicles were dropped, so management likely sees it as meeting aspirations for the new direction.
The building material lift shares a platform and customer base with the furniture lift, so the slack and synergies make it cheap to carry and give little reason for problemistic search.
The truck-mounted lift is a more specialised variant within the same lift family, and as a coherent part of the firm's refocused range it is likely retained despite slightly more uncertain demand.
